description: This file contains implementations of functions related to HTTP/2 protocol constants, including string conversions for frame types, flags, error codes, and settings parameters, as well as invalid header name sets.

methods.name: Http2FrameTypeToString
methods.description: Converts Http2FrameType enum to its string representation.

methods.name: Http2FrameTypeToString
methods.description: Overloaded function that converts a uint8_t to string by casting to Http2FrameType.

methods.name: Http2FrameFlagsToString
methods.description: Converts frame type and flags to a human-readable string.

methods.name: Http2FrameFlagsToString
methods.description: Overloaded function that converts type and flags from uint8_t to string.

methods.name: Http2ErrorCodeToString
methods.description: Converts error code uint32_t or enum to string.

methods.name: Http2SettingsParameterToString
methods.description: Converts settings parameter uint32_t or enum to string.

methods.name: GetInvalidHttp2HeaderSet
methods.description: Returns a set of invalid HTTP/2 header names based on runtime flags.
